bio.text: Alan Armstrong was appointed by Gov. Kevin Stitt in March 2026 to fill the Oklahoma U.S. Senate seat vacated by Markwayne Mullin and was sworn in the same day.
He joined Williams Companies as an engineer in 1986 and led it as president and CEO from 2011 through 2025 and as executive chairman through March 2026.
He holds a B.S. in civil engineering from the University of Oklahoma (1985), was raised in Bartlesville, and lives in Tulsa.
